sources.title: Path of Exile Developer Docs: Data Exports
sources.gameOrSoftwareVersion: Path of Exile developer documentation accessed for the 3.29.1 evidence freeze
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Identifies grindinggear/skilltree-export as GGG's official PoE1 Passive Skill Tree export.
States that the official PoE1 data-export exception covers the Passive and Atlas trees.
sources.limitations: The documentation identifies the export but does not itself establish individual node mechanics, current item data, or redistribution rights for the raw export.
sources.notes: Used to establish official provenance for the separately pinned tree data record.

sources.title: Official Path of Exile 1 Passive Skill Tree export, 3.29.1
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Pins the Default tree used by AUD-003, including Golden Glory node 31517, Light Radius nodes, mastery effect 51424, direct Link Skill Buff Effect nodes, and relevant condition text.
Provides a bounded, reproducible Default-tree scan with 3,390 nodes at the recorded data.json hash.
sources.limitations: The Default-tree export does not establish equipment availability, item ranges, source completeness outside the scanned tree, arithmetic, stacking, runtime condition state, rounding, or a redistribution grant for raw game data.
sources.notes: Relevant raw file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grindinggear/skilltree-export/8bd138b32ea2631455cac5935bfab089f826094f/data.json. The repository had no declared GitHub license or LICENSE file at inspection; raw data is not vendored.

sources.title: Official Path of Exile Trade stats vocabulary capture
sources.gameOrSoftwareVersion: No patch-version field; captured during the Path of Exile 1 3.29.1 evidence freeze
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Identifies the official Trade filter vocabulary for the Light Radius and direct Link Skill Buff Effect term records retained by AUD-003.
Supports identifier/text recognition only, not item availability or source completeness.
sources.limitations: The endpoint has no embedded game-version field and does not establish a modifier's item slot, natural range, local/global scope, acquisition, current availability, or arithmetic behavior.
sources.notes: The raw response is not retained. Minimal filter IDs and review states are retained in AUD-003 curated artifacts.

sources.title: Will the Crucible League go Core?
supportedClaimsOrRecords: States that Crucible would not go core and existing items with Crucible trees would move to Standard.
sources.limitations: Does not establish a current item listing, acquisition route, range, active effect, or availability of any particular Crucible term in 3.29.1.
sources.notes: AUD-003 treats related Trade vocabulary as legacy-or-unknown rather than a current recommendation.

sources.title: Path of Building Community dev snapshot with 3.29 data
sources.gameOrSoftwareVersion: dev commit 50d22365b919c7435b5d12d892875e9f61d11133, inspected 2026-08-03; includes 3_29 tree/data paths
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Provides supporting parser/catalog cross-checks for signed Light Radius text and the documented Helmet corruption range disagreement.
Provides supporting source/data cross-checks for AUD-004 Flame Link and AUD-005 Enmity records without becoming permanent-Mercenary authority.
sources.limitations: A moving development snapshot is not a target-version official game-data release or authority for permanent-Mercenary mechanics. Its MIT software license does not establish redistribution rights for embedded GGG game data.
sources.notes: Inspected without executing code. Relevant AUD-003 paths include src/TreeData/3_29/tree.lua, src/Data/ModExplicit.lua, src/Data/ModCorrupted.lua, src/Data/Crucible.lua, src/Data/ModItemExclusive.lua, and src/Data/ModCache.lua.

sources.title: Path of Exile Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Records the audit's retention risk: official game material should not be treated as affirmatively licensed for broad copying, storage, distribution, or derivative data publication without review.
sources.limitations: This registry record is a provenance/risk note, not legal advice or a legal determination. It does not supersede a later reviewed licence or permission decision.
sources.notes: AUD artifacts retain minimal factual records, stable locators, hashes, and attribution rather than raw game-data payloads, broad copied prose, or image assets.

sources.title: Path of Exile 3.29.1 Patch Notes
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Pins the evidence pack to Path of Exile 1 3.29.1 on 2026-08-03.
Provides the target-patch context for the first-release audits; it does not independently restate every 3.29.0 feature or item record.
sources.limitations: Patch notes are not a complete game-data snapshot and do not establish unchanged behavior for features or items not discussed in the notes.
sources.notes: GGG page licensing was not stated in the inspected patch notes. Audit artifacts retain source locators and minimal factual records rather than copied prose or page assets.

sources.title: Content Update 3.29.0 ? Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame
sources.gameOrSoftwareVersion: Path of Exile 1 3.29.0, Curse of the Allflame
supportedClaimsOrRecords: States that the Luminary can have up to three permanent Mercenaries with one active Mercenary.
States that a Luminary can change permanent-Mercenary equipment and inspect an information sheet listing passive stats.
Records the official 3.29.0 wording used to bound AUD-002 and the Light Radius corruption disagreement in AUD-003.
sources.limitations: This is an announcement for 3.29.0, not a versioned 3.29.1 UI/data schema. It does not identify sheet labels, units, inclusion rules, precision, conditions, or every current modifier range.
sources.notes: GGG page licensing was not stated in the inspected announcement. No page assets or bulk text are retained.

sources.title: Anonymous community report about a Luminary Mercenary Defence page
sources.gameOrSoftwareVersion: Reported as Path of Exile 1 3.29 context; exact client version and mode not preserved
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Identifies a candidate question about whether a Mercenary Defence page updates for a player aura, motivating AUD-002's controlled-observation request.
sources.limitations: Anonymous text report only: no original image, exact Mercenary, level, equipment, field labels, aura, realm, zone, or controlled before/after state. It establishes no universal display or mechanics rule.
sources.notes: No Reddit content or image is retained in curated data; the audit retains only the locator and its limitation.

sources.title: Path of Building Community 2.66.2 source snapshot
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Pins the current public release used as the primary AUD-001 format profile.
Provides the release implementation for share-code intake, XML loading and saving, item pools, item sets, slots, jewels, and item-set cross-references.
sources.limitations: This is an implementation snapshot, not a formal or forward-compatible serialization specification. The XML does not embed this application version.
sources.notes: Release page: https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/releases/tag/v2.66.2. Relevant paths were compared with the separately pinned dev snapshot.

sources.title: Path of Building Community current item-set and import implementation
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Defines current share-code Base64 substitutions and the calls to host Deflate and Inflate.
Defines the PathOfBuilding root loader and saver plus current item-pool, item-set, slot, active-set, alternate-weapon, Abyssal-slot, passive-jewel, and minion item-set-reference behavior.
Shows that item and item-set IDs are local numeric keys, item-set order is mutable, item text can contain a Unique ID line, and API reimport currently matches that value when present.
Shows current legacy handling for top-level Item/Slot assignments and current normalization or omission behavior that Golden Glory Lab must not treat as preservation guarantees.
sources.limitations: The source is a moving development snapshot and not a formal schema. Current PoB ignores some unknown structures, can reset invalid references, and rebuilds item text when saving.
sources.notes: Inspected exact paths and symbols: src/Classes/ImportTab.lua (self.controls.generateCode callback, local importCodeHandle callback, ImportItem, ImportSocketedItems, GetOrCreateGuardianItemSet, AssignGuardianItemSet); src/Modules/Build.lua (buildMode:LoadDB, buildMode:SaveDB); src/Classes/ItemsTab.lua (Load, Save, NewItemSet, SetActiveItemSet, AddItem, IsItemValidForSlot); src/Classes/ItemSlotControl.lua (SetSelItemId, Populate); src/Classes/PassiveSpec.lua (Load, Save); src/Classes/TreeTab.lua (Load, Save); src/Classes/SkillsTab.lua (LoadSkill, Save); src/Classes/Item.lua (ParseRaw, BuildRaw, BuildAndParseRaw); src/Classes/ItemSetListControl.lua; runtime/lua/base64.lua; src/GameVersions.lua.

sources.title: Path of Building 1.4.37 item-set introduction
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Introduces ItemSet elements with numeric IDs, titles, per-set alternate-weapon state, and nested Slot references.
Demonstrates a transitional saver that writes both the active legacy top-level Slot representation and nested ItemSet representations.
sources.limitations: This historical implementation does not establish the current format or a permanent compatibility guarantee.
sources.notes: The changelog at the same commit was also inspected: https://github.com/PathOfBuildingCommunity/PathOfBuilding/blob/9f981583f7c721917124d604cddf0e8102e62714/changelog.txt. It describes item sets as switchable gear configurations and selectable for minions.

sources.title: Path of Building 1.4.36 pre-item-set serialization
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Shows the legacy Items representation with a document item pool, top-level Slot elements, and Items/useSecondWeaponSet before ItemSet elements existed.
sources.limitations: This historical implementation only supports the bounded legacy profile; it is not evidence for current slot vocabulary or current item parsing.
sources.notes: Commit subject is Release 1.4.36. Exact Load and Save implementations in Classes/ItemsTab.lua were inspected.

sources.title: Path of Building API import and reimport tests
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Provides current regression evidence that API reimport preserves a selected minion item-set reference in its covered case.
Provides synthetic API import/reimport examples relevant to the boundary around item Unique ID matching.
sources.limitations: The tests do not define the complete XML grammar, malformed-input behavior, Golden Glory Lab preservation behavior, or cross-document identifier stability.
sources.notes: Used only to bound direct test coverage; implementation claims are tied to the source snapshot record.

sources.title: Path of Building SimpleGraphic zlib host functions
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Defines the host l_Deflate and l_Inflate functions called by Path of Building's share-code implementation.
Shows that those functions initialize zlib streams and documents their current size checks, including the ineffective oversized-input branch in l_Inflate.
sources.limitations: Host limits and implementation details can change. In this snapshot l_Inflate pushes an error for input over 128 MiB but does not return. Its initial output allocation is not capped by the nominal output threshold, and its later growth check can grow once beyond that threshold. These checks do not define or satisfy Golden Glory Lab's future safety limits.
sources.notes: Relevant symbols are l_Deflate and l_Inflate in ui_api.cpp; the main PoB repository supplies the Base64 and URL-safe substitution steps.

sources.title: Path of Building committed 3.13 build fixtures
sources.gameOrSoftwareVersion: Historical 3.13 fixtures retained at dev commit ef4c5848fad33190f730cebaedff4b5831d0c88d
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Provides committed examples of copied-item text, item-pool references, empty nested item-set slots, legacy top-level slots, passive-tree jewel references, and a minion item-set reference.
sources.limitations: Only five old fixtures are present. Each has one unnamed item set; they do not cover named multiple sets, active alternate weapons, non-empty Abyssal equipment slots, malformed input, or all current fields.
sources.notes: These are incidental implementation fixtures, not a formal schema or Path of Exile mechanics authority.

sources.title: Python 3.13 zlib standard-library documentation
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Documents that positive MAX_WBITS requires the zlib header and trailer rather than raw DEFLATE.
Documents bounded Decompress.decompress max_length output, unconsumed_tail handling, unused_data after stream end, and eof detection for complete versus truncated streams.
sources.limitations: Documents the Python 3.13 API; packaged runtimes must still exercise their exact Python and zlib versions through the retained regression suite.

sources.title: Python 3.13 xml.parsers.expat documentation
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Documents incremental Parse calls, ordered_attributes, DTD and external-entity handlers, parameter-entity controls, and parser error locations.
Documents Expat reparse deferral and entity-amplification protections in the proof runtime line.
sources.limitations: Expat exposes XML-normalized event data, not trustworthy byte-exact element spans. Handler limits run after Expat recognizes a token, so the importer also relies on its pre-parse whole-XML byte limit.

sources.title: Python 3.13 history, license, and incorporated-software notices
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Records the Python Software Foundation License Version 2 and the incorporated Expat and zlib license notices used by the selected standard-library implementation.
sources.limitations: This record documents implementation-dependency licenses; it does not declare a license for the Golden Glory Lab repository.

sources.title: setuptools 75.8.2 package metadata
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Pins the proof package build backend version and records its Python requirement and MIT license metadata.
sources.limitations: This is a build-time dependency only. The importer has no third-party runtime package dependency.

sources.title: Python 3.13 XML security guidance
supportedClaimsOrRecords: Documents denial-of-service and memory risks in vulnerable Expat versions, including exponential entity expansion, quadratic blowup, and large-token reparsing.
Records Python's guidance to check pyexpat.EXPAT_VERSION and the current statement that Expat versions before 2.7.2 may be vulnerable.
sources.limitations: The 2.7.2 floor is a conservative runtime admission gate based on current Python documentation, not a claim that every future Expat security issue is covered. Packaged runtimes must report and re-exercise their exact version.
